description: Verifies atomic publication rules: staged tables without a committed MANIFEST.json are invisible, and manifests with missing files, SHA-256 mismatches, or row_count mismatches are rejected atomically.

steps.description: Staged table files without a committed MANIFEST.json are invisible.
Manifest committed while outcomes table file is missing from storage.
Manifest committed with corrupted usage table SHA-256 digest.
Manifest committed with mismatched sessions row_count.
Complete atomic publication of snapshot_sequence=1 succeeds.
